title: BuildIt
summary: An AI-powered no-code platform where users describe an application in plain language and multi-step agent workflows generate it, with paid plans and secure access built in.
overview: A no-code application generation platform: users describe what they want in natural language, and agentic AI workflows plan and generate a working application.

I worked across the frontend and backend, integrating the LLM that drives generation, securing the platform with RBAC, and adding subscription billing, working directly with the founder on what to build and how.

points: Integrated Google Gemini to drive AI application generation and multi-step agent workflows.
Developed and maintained frontend features in React.js and backend APIs in FastAPI and Flask.
Worked across PostgreSQL, Firebase and Azure for the platform’s application, data and cloud infrastructure.
Implemented RBAC plus authentication and authorization flows to secure features and user access.
Integrated Stripe subscriptions and payment workflows for paid plans and recurring billing.
Worked directly with the founder on product requirements, technical decisions and production delivery.
Mentored junior developers, ran code reviews and contributed to end-to-end feature design.

achievements: Shipped AI-driven app generation on multi-step agent workflows.
Took the platform to paid plans with recurring Stripe billing.
Founder-facing technical partner on product direction.
